LanguageData.VFEI2_Patriarch.description: The gargantuan patriarch of the Sorne geneline serves as the primary male responsible for the survival and protection of the royal caste. His immense digger claws, essential for both hive construction and defense, double as formidable shields capable of absorbing extraordinary amounts of damage. Mounted on his back are vast insect jelly sacks, which provide the resources necessary for rapidly constructing any hive defenses. In battle, his sets of extremely sharp ripper blades and razor-sharp mandibles can efficiently dispatch any threat to the hive. The Patriarch possesses the ability to summon royal caste insectoids from deep underground tunnels, enabling reinforcements to swiftly emerge onto the surface. Upon death, it’s possible to extract a Sorne pherocore from his body.
